title: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1 - Ethics & Professional Responsibilities - Perjury by a Witness
exam: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1
subject: Ethics & Professional Responsibilities

questions.q: Ten minutes before a hearing, a client informs their paralegal that their star witness is planning to lie on the stand to guarantee they win the case. The client insists the paralegal still call the witness to testify. What is the paralegal's mandatory response?
options: Call the witness but refuse to ask them questions related to the lie.
Inform the client that the paralegal cannot knowingly offer false evidence, and if the client insists on calling the witness, the paralegal must seek to withdraw.
Call the witness to the stand, but immediately inform the adjudicator that the witness is lying.
Lock the witness out of the hearing room to prevent them from testifying.
questions.explain: Rule 8.02 (Mandatory Withdrawal) combined with Rule 2.01 (Duty to the Tribunal). A paralegal must not knowingly offer false evidence or permit a witness to lie. If a client insists on doing so, the paralegal must withdraw because the client's instructions require the paralegal to violate the rules of professional conduct.
